_comment: Drop this into ~/.claude/settings.json under the existing 'hooks' key. Claude Code reads it at startup; PostToolUse fires after every tool call. The hook command must be on PATH — installed via `uv tool install agent-platform-telemetry-shim`. Required env vars (AGENT_PLATFORM_TELEMETRY_BASE_URL, AGENT_PLATFORM_TELEMETRY_TOKEN) are typically baked into the agent VM by cloud-init.
